_comment: HUMAN-EDITED. This file is NEVER sent to the scoring model — the model decides WHETHER a habit was missed, agent_coach.py decides WHAT link to render. Run `agent_coach.py courses refresh` to re-verify: a course is only ever suggested if its last fetch returned HTTP 200.
credit_policy: auto = Coursera, Duke pays and completion auto-reports. manual = free certificate you log by hand. none = free content but the certificate is paywalled, so it cannot count toward a training record. Order every category auto > manual > none. Maven evals training is deliberately absent: it is paid and we do not point staff at paid courses.

_unmapped_by_design.protect-secrets: The inline warning IS the right response. No course needed.
_unmapped_by_design.verify-before-done: Nearest honest fit is AI evals training; the strong one is paid (Maven). A wrong pointer costs more credibility than a missing one.
_unmapped_by_design.avoid-thrash: No honest Anthropic/Coursera course teaches this specifically.
_unmapped_by_design.small-batches: No honest Anthropic/Coursera course teaches this specifically.

_depth_courses_no_habit_mapping._why: Depth courses, not habit fixes. No rubric category means the coach never nudges you toward them — take them on purpose. Listed here so `courses` can find them.

topics._why: Explicit 'how do I learn X' requests. Unlike habit categories these are not misses — the user ASKED, so the repetition and cooldown gates are bypassed. Ordered auto > manual > none.
